inline_comments.comment: The PR description explicitly states: 'Note: `deviceAddons` is intentionally not added to the shared `StorybookConfigRaw` core type since it is React Native-specific.' Yet this diff adds it. Adding a renderer-specific field to the shared `StorybookConfigRaw` interface widens the core type for all Storybook users regardless of whether they use React Native. If the intent is for `deviceAddons` to be documented and validated at the type level, this should likely live in a React Native-specific config interface (or at minimum be called out in a `@remarks` tag as not applicable outside RN). Please reconcile the implementation with the stated design decision in the PR description.

The `run` tests cover an all-string array and an all-object array separately, but not a mixed array (e.g., `['@storybook/addon-ondevice-controls', { name: '@storybook/addon-ondevice-actions', options: {} }]`). Adding a mixed-case test would give full confidence that the loop correctly handles both forms together in a single pass, and that the interleaved `removeEntryFromArray` / `appendValueToArray` calls are issued in the right order.

general_comments.comment: The detection heuristic (`getAddonName(addon).includes('ondevice')`) is simple and effective for the current ecosystem. However, it is documented nowhere in the code. An inline comment explaining the convention — e.g., 'All React Native on-device addons from @storybook follow the `addon-ondevice-*` naming pattern' — would help future maintainers evaluate whether the heuristic needs updating if new on-device addons are introduced with a different naming scheme.

The MIGRATION.md diff is absent from the provided change set, but the `link` field in the fix and the PR description both reference a specific anchor (`#react-native-on-device-addons-moved-to-deviceaddons`). If the anchor string in the link doesn't exactly match the heading Markdown generates (e.g., due to capitalisation or punctuation differences), the link will 404. Verify the anchor is correct once the MIGRATION.md entry is merged.
